title: 야근의 불빛
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Indie Rock. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern in the verses. A melodic bass guitar line follows the vocal phrasing with occasional slides. Drums feature a tight snare and consistent hi-hat eighth notes. The chorus introduces overdriven electric guitar power chords and open crash cymbals. Male vocals are delivered in a mid-range tenor with light compression and subtle plate reverb. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of B Major. The arrangement transitions from a sparse, rhythmic verse to a dense, wall-of-sound chorus with layered vocal harmonies.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with palm muting, steady kick drum]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals enter]
사수자리에 [bass guitar enters]
포스팅만 남아
노란 종이에
적힌 암호야
검색해도 안 나와
허상인 거란 걸
알았어 그제야

[Pre-Chorus]
[hi-hats become more prominent]
모니터 불빛이
내 얼굴을 비춰
새벽 두 시야
자판 소리만 남아
푸른 그림자야

[Chorus]
[distorted electric guitar enters, full drum kit with crash cymbals]
꺼지지 않아
이 불빛은
내가 여기 있어
